svg.aria-label: S10 Decode, eight decoders and what each one emits
svg.text: S10 Decode, eight decoders and what each one emits
Eight instructions come in a cycle. Each decoder emits one micro-op, a split pair or a fused pair, and the pair detector sits between neighbours. The player lights the decoder and the output it took.
a decoder and its right neighbour
ALU op then b.cond, cbz or cbnz
the pair leaves decoder k as one
The player lights the output a decoder took.
○ A shifted ALU op stays one micro-op and issues twice.
pre and post index add a writeback micro-op
LDP and fused pairs issue once
flag-ALU+b.cc, ALU+cbz/cbnz, aese+aesmc, aesd+aesimc, aes+eor, pmull+eor, amx+amx
